06/13.09.2024 Heard learned senior counsel for the applicant and learned
 A.P.P. for the State.

2.  This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant- Ritik Bharti with prayer to release on bail in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No. 45 of 2024 arising out of Pathargama P.S. Case No.46 of 2024 registered under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and section 4/6 of the POCSO Act (charge sheet has been submitted u/s 417 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and section 6 of the POCSO Act),
pending in the court of learned Special Judge (POCSO), Godda.
3.
The FIR of this case was lodged by the victim herself wherein the allegations are made that victim came in contact of Ritik Bharti one year ago over the mobile phone.
He was saying to marry with her.
On 22.02.2024 he called her to Pathargama where his sister-in-law (bhabhi) resides.
Victim went there and thereto he established physical relation with her.
He also snatched away her mobile phone on 23.02.2024 and deleted all the data and victim is also pregnant.
The accused has refused her to marry, hence this FIR was lodged.
4. As per allegations made in the FIR, the age of victim is shown 17 years.
The statement of victim u/s 164 of Cr.PC was also recorded in which she stated that she has been loving to Ritik Bharti for one year back.
While she had gone to take tution Ritik Bharti had called her to the house of his Bhabhi and thereto he established physical relation with her.
On 02 nd February, he took her to Basi and in a hotel he established physical relation with her.
Thereafter, he stated that he would not marry with her.

1 5.
In view of para-22 of case diary, as per mark-sheet of high school the date of birth of victim is shown 03.02.2007.
As such on date of occurrence victim was minor.
The medical examination report of victim is in para-37 of the case diary.
Victim was examined on 22.03.2024.
As per medical examination report, the pregnancy test of victim is shown negative and no definite opinion is given in regard to the recent sexual assault.
6. The medical report being contrary to the statement of victim, the bail application of the applicant is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid case.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Rashmi Ritik Bharti vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp. ... on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32150826/
